bugs.root_cause: Original style.css had invalid CSS declarations `translate(15px, 0px);` (a function call with no property) inside the 768px and 480px `.hero__logo-mark` media blocks. Browsers silently ignore malformed declarations, so the legacy site rendered fine; Astro's PostCSS pipeline hard-errors on them.
bugs.fix: Removed the two stray `translate(15px, 0px);` lines. Browsers already ignored them, so rendering is byte-identical; the valid `transform: translate(9px, 0.5px);` in the 480px block and the base `.hero__logo-mark` transform are untouched.

bugs.error_message: og:image referenced og-image.svg which never existed in the repo
bugs.root_cause: Legacy index.html line 30 set `<meta property="og:image" content="og-image.svg">` but no such file was ever committed; social cards were broken. SVG og:image is also unsupported by most crawlers.
bugs.fix: Created public/og-default.svg (Workshop-at-Night branded card) and scripts/build-og.mjs to rasterize it to public/og-default.png via sharp. Seo.astro defaults og:image to /og-default.png, resolved against the site URL.

bugs.error_message: openwolf designqc auto-detected the wrong dev server (captured Memgraph Lab, not the Kigumi Astro site)
bugs.root_cause: designqc auto-detect picked another running local dev server (Memgraph Lab on a different port) instead of Astro on localhost:4321. It also wipes .wolf/designqc-captures/ on every run, so prior captures are lost; and a single --url run does not reliably crawl to other routes.
bugs.fix: Always pass `openwolf designqc --url http://localhost:4321[/route]` explicitly. Capture and READ one route group per run before the next run wipes the dir. Do not rely on crawl reaching /writing.

bugs.error_message: Cannot find namespace 'z'; implicit any parameters; LabNav label type mismatch
